annotations.title: Kundli (birth chart) from birth details, read in plain words

description: Reads a person's birth chart from their date, time and place of birth: their core nature, the life phase they are in now and when it changes, the standout strengths in the chart, and which life areas look strong or need care, with what helps. Useful when the user talks about themselves, a family member or someone they know and wants to understand them better: personality, a life change, career or marriage timing, feeling stuck, or what to work on. Also for direct requests in English, Hindi or Hinglish: "make my kundli", "kundli for my birth details", "what is my rashi / lagna / nakshatra", "meri kundli banao", "janam kundali dikhao", "mera lagna kya hai". Calculated by AstroCalc's ephemeris engine (sidereal zodiac, Lahiri ayanamsa). Returns Lagna (ascendant), Moon sign (rashi), Sun sign, nakshatra and pada, the running Vimshottari Mahadasha and Antardasha with dates, the most notable yoga with how rare it is ("1 in N charts"), life areas that are strong or need care, a caveat, and a link to the full free report. Birth details are used only to compute the chart in memory and are not stored. Results are traditional astrology information, not predictions or professional advice.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).

lat.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees (north positive). Give together with lon.

lon.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees (east positive). Give together with lat.

place.description: Birth city or town, e.g. 'Lucknow' or 'Pune, Maharashtra, India'. The best match is used (Indian cities preferred); call search_place first if unsure. Not needed when lat and lon are given.

time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. '06:45', '21:10'); '6:45 am' / '9:10 PM' also work. Use 'unknown' (or omit) if not known: noon is used, the Moon sign stays reliable but the Lagna is approximate.
